items.title: Gemini for Home just fixed one of its strangest limitations
items.excerpt: Google's September update gives Gemini for Home better media and smart-home control plus easier automation management, closing gaps that made the LLM assistant worse than the old Assistant at basic tasks.

items.title: My years-old gaming PC became the best AI machine in the house
items.excerpt: A three-year-old gaming PC turned into the household's best local-inference box with a single upgrade — VRAM, the writer argues, is the new oil for on-device AI.

items.title: Google has unveiled 5 new Android features, including Motion Assist and Guided V
items.excerpt: Five new AI features are rolling out across Android, touching Google Messages, Gemini Live and Find Hub — the steady drip of assistant capability landing on existing phones.

items.title: iOS 27 basically turns your iPhone and AirPods into an Apple Watch at the gym
items.excerpt: iOS 27 extends GymKit-style sensing to the iPhone and AirPods, letting the earbuds and phone stand in for a watch for workout tracking — wearable sensing without the wearable.

items.title: Amazon's AI assistant can now spot fake emails from the company
items.excerpt: Alexa for Shopping will now check a suspicious text or email and tell you whether Amazon actually sent it — an assistant task framed as fraud defense rather than convenience.

items.title: The best tech and gadgets announced at IFA so far
items.excerpt: The Verge's running IFA 2026 roundup: a gaming handheld that doubles as a work machine, a robovac that seals itself to the floor, AI headphones and more repairable laptops.

items.title: Looks Like Smart Glasses Are a 'No' for OpenAI
items.excerpt: Sam Altman says he finds talking to people wearing face cameras uncomfortable, a notable signal from the company most expected to chase the AI glasses form factor.

items.title: Caira's AI mirrorless camera is getting 'Nano Banana for video editing'
items.excerpt: Caira's generative video tools let you reshape footage with natural-language instructions, but only on clips you actually shot — keeping the original recording at the center of every edit.

items.title: Qualcomm's upcoming premium chip has Adreno 'Neural Fusion' GPU
items.excerpt: Qualcomm detailed a next-gen Snapdragon GPU whose 'Neural Fusion' block folds neural rendering into the graphics pipeline — an on-device AI upscaling path baked into the phone silicon itself.

items.title: Researchers build a $7 smartphone clip-on that spots hidden cameras
items.excerpt: Korean researchers built a $7 phone clip-on that uses a dynamic LED grid plus AI to separate lens reflections from ordinary glare, hitting 94% accuracy at finding hidden cameras.

items.title: Circular's New Smart Ring Brings Mobile Payments to Your Finger
items.excerpt: The Circular Ring 3 Pro and Slim add NFC payments and haptics while keeping the AI health coach and core insights subscription-free — a rare no-paywall pitch in the smart ring category.

items.title: iRobot's new $1,199 Roomba Max 875 Combo is its most powerful robot yet
items.excerpt: iRobot launched the $1,199 Roomba Max 875 Combo and $899 Roomba Plus 678 Combo at IFA 2026, leaning on smarter obstacle and surface recognition to justify the flagship price.

items.title: Acer debuts Aspire G 3D 16: glasses-free 3D laptop that can run large AI models locally
items.excerpt: Acer's Aspire G 3D 16 pairs a glasses-free 3D 3840x2400 120 Hz panel with a Ryzen AI Max+ 395 and up to 128 GB RAM, aimed at creatives who want local model inference on the same machine.

items.title: Asus puts a petaflop of AI ambition into ProArt laptops
items.excerpt: At IFA 2026 Asus pushed its creator-focused ProArt P16 and P14 deeper into local AI, claiming petaflop-class performance for on-machine generative work.

items.title: Norway takes aim at smart glasses with plans for tighter regulations
items.excerpt: Norway's digital minister is weighing strict smart-glasses rules including a ban on facial recognition, arguing always-on face computers erase public anonymity.

items.title: Google Pixel Watch 5 gets offline Gemini and new gestures in September update
items.excerpt: Google's first big Pixel Watch 5 update adds offline Gemini and expanded one-handed gestures, putting an assistant on the wrist that keeps working without a phone or network.

items.title: Acer shows off its AI desktop future with the RTX Spark design
items.excerpt: Acer's IFA concept desktop is built around NVIDIA's RTX Spark local-AI hardware, positioning a personal machine that runs large models on the desk rather than in a data center.

items.title: I tried Rokid's AI + AR glasses for a month
items.excerpt: A month of daily wear with Rokid's AI + AR glasses: the reviewer's general unease about face-worn wearables eased, but the data questions never went away.

items.title: HUMAIN Horizon Ultra AI PC unveiled with Snapdragon X2 Elite and on-device AI
items.excerpt: Qualcomm and HUMAIN showed the Horizon Ultra at LEAP 2026: a Snapdragon X2 Elite AI PC that runs models locally and only escalates to the cloud when a task needs more headroom.

items.title: New Android Drop adds remembered items in Find Hub, connects Gemini to Find Hub
items.excerpt: September's Android Drop wires Gemini into Find Hub so the assistant can recall where you left physical items, alongside new Keep and Messages features rolling out across the ecosystem.

items.title: Perplexity launches privacy-minded 'hybrid compute' AI feature for Mac
items.excerpt: Perplexity's new Hybrid Compute keeps sensitive AI work on the Mac's own silicon and only reaches for the cloud when a query needs more power — a local-first split for desktop assistants.
